verdict.rationale: Daytona documents 'Computer Use' for programmatic control of desktop environments (mouse, keyboard, screenshot, screen recording) within sandboxes, and offers Windows VM sandboxes for full desktop/OS use cases, directly supporting headless/full desktop scenarios. However, there's no explicit mention of a dedicated headless browser feature (e.g., pre-installed Chromium/Playwright), and no community evidence validates real-world use of these desktop/browser capabilities, only vendor docs.
